Benchmark v2 — final scene set

The emitted benchmark_scenarios_v2.yaml, scene by scene. Captions carry the pixel-certified visible fractions from generation time. Occluder catalog: 2 beds, 2 tables, 2 cabinets, curtain, IV pole.

Sampler seed 20260725. Randomized poses under family constraints; occlusion and FOV families certified into named bands via id-buffer raster (sim intrinsics fx = 443.53, 640×480, camera at (0.25, 0, 0.85)). Background occluders additionally certified visible (≥ 200–250 px). Runner: repeats:=1; probe scenes carry repeats_override: 8.

Single robot — stratified yaw

8 scenes

2 scenes per yaw stratum: facing, side, back, free.

Multi-instance

8 scenes

All-visible groups (each robot certified ≥ 0.85), shoulder-merge pairs, association-swap pairs.

Inter-robot occlusion — banded

6 scenes

Far robot on the near robot’s bearing; certified bands: moderate 0.15–0.45, sliver 0.03–0.15, near-total < 0.03.

Interference without occlusion

9 scenes

Object couples through image space, depth band, or bearing — robot ≥ 0.97 visible, occluder certified visible too. Controls double as a detector false-positive sweep across shapes.

Object occlusion — banded

10 scenes

Occluder offset solved against the certifier: heavy 0.02–0.20 visible, partial 0.35–0.65. Shapes stratified: beds, curtain, cabinets, table.

Range extremes

8 scenes

Near-limit frame clipping; far targets; straddling the 10 m depth clamp.

FOV edge — banded center ratio

5 scenes

Bands: mostly-in 0.88–0.96, half-out 0.99–1.04, sliver 1.10–1.18.

Aimed estimator traps

10 scenes

Split (curtain/IV pole, bisection verified on the raster), lidar block vs table pass-through pair, bbox-bottom lift, contact bleed, layered front+back depth attack.

Kitchen sink

4 scenes

3 robots + 2–3 catalog objects; every robot 0.25–0.97 visible, at least one under 0.75.
